_comment: DGN-1962 recall supersession lexicon (data, not code). groups: subject -> lowercase substrings; two recalled lines naming the same entity and the same group are on the same subject (newest wins), and a kit fact whose text hits a group covers that subject. expectation_markers: substrings that make a line a future expectation (stale once its date passes). entities: instance names (name -> aliases) that key supersession besides kit entities; prompt words never do. fraction_units: a word right after N/M that makes it a fraction, not a month/day (ASCII words match whole, others by prefix).
